Visual tools for 3D plasma simulation: GPU-based isosurface extraction ...
A slab-based, two-pass GPU isosurface-extraction pipeline that combines exact output allocation with boundary-consistent indexing for large scalar grids. A tightly coupled extraction and rendering workflow that writes the generated geometry directly to an interoperable graphics buffer.
